abstract: We study an intervention that reduced cesarean deliveries among low-risk first-time mothers, using California birth records linked to earnings data. Exposed mothers were 8% less likely to have a c-section, with no adverse health effects. We find suggestive evidence that they were more likely to return to their pre-birth employer and had higher within-firm earnings rankings in the quarter postbirth. These labor market gains fade over time. However, mothers who had a second child were less likely to have a c-section or preterm delivery, suggesting our estimated effects from avoiding a first c-section may be lower bounds on total gains.

abstract: We introduce a definition of multivariate majorization that is new to the economics literature. We exploit it to generalize Mussa and Rosen’s (1978) “ironing” to mechanism design problems in which agents’ types are one dimensional but value interdependencies create a multidimensional ironing problem. Our multidimensional ironing technique is constructive, computationally simple, and applies to discrete and continuous type spaces alike. We use it for the optimal design of club goods.

title: Why did air conditioning adoption accelerate faster than predicted? Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: 为什么空调普及速度超出预期？来自墨西哥的证据
title_primary: 为什么空调普及速度超出预期？来自墨西哥的证据
title_secondary: Why did air conditioning adoption accelerate faster than predicted? Evidence from Mexico
authors: Lucas W. Davis, Paul Gertler
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A common theme in the vast literature on climate change is the estimation of models using historical data to make predictions many decades into the future. Although there is a large and growing number of these types of studies, researchers rarely return later to check the accuracy of their predictions. In this paper, we perform such an exercise. In Davis and Gertler (2015), we used household-level microdata from Mexico to predict future air conditioning adoption as a function of income and temperature. Revisiting these predictions with 12 years of additional data, we find that air conditioning in Mexico has accelerated, significantly exceeding our predictions. This large prediction gap is not explained by income growth, rising temperatures, migration patterns, or an overly restrictive model. Instead, the evidence points to decreased electricity prices and technological change in air conditioning as potential explanations.
abstract_zh: 关于气候变化的大量文献中，一个共同的主题是利用历史数据估计模型，以预测未来数十年后的情况。尽管这类研究数量庞大且日益增多，但研究者们很少在事后回头检验其预测的准确性。本文即开展这样一项检验工作。在Davis和Gertler（2015）的研究中，我们利用墨西哥的家庭层面微观数据，预测了未来空调普及率作为收入和温度的函数。借助额外12年的数据重新审视这些预测，我们发现墨西哥的空调普及速度已加快，显著超出了我们的预测。这一巨大的预测差距并不能由收入增长、气温上升、人口迁移模式或模型设定过于严格来解释。相反，证据指向电价下降和空调技术进步作为可能的解释因素。

title: Spillover Effects of Transfer Programs
title_zh: 转移支付项目的溢出效应
title_primary: 转移支付项目的溢出效应
title_secondary: Spillover Effects of Transfer Programs
authors: Travis Baseler, Jules Gazeaud, Erik Snowberg
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We derive four facts from experiments on the spillover effects of cash and in-kind transfer programs onto non-recipients: (1) average spillovers on consumption and asset value are negligible; (2) negative psychological spillovers emerge in the longer term among households randomly excluded from transfers by within-village lotteries; (3) these spillovers are concentrated in consumption-poor households; and (4) they do not appear when the selection of transfer recipients is eligibility-based. These findings are consistent with household preferences against within-village randomization of transfers, and point to additional benefits of cluster-level randomized designs over household-level ones.
abstract_zh: 我们从关于现金与实物转移支付项目对非受益者溢出效应的实验中得出四个事实：（1）对消费和资产价值的平均溢出效应可忽略不计；（2）在村内抽签随机排除在转移支付之外的住户中，长期内出现了负面的心理溢出效应；（3）这些溢出效应集中在消费贫困家庭中；（4）当转移支付受益者的选择基于资格标准时，这些效应并未显现。这些发现与家庭对村内随机分配转移支付的偏好相悖，并指出了集群级随机设计相对于家庭级设计的额外优势。

title: Supply Chain Resilience: Evidence from Indian Firms
title_zh: 供应链韧性：来自印度企业的证据
title_primary: 供应链韧性：来自印度企业的证据
title_secondary: Supply Chain Resilience: Evidence from Indian Firms
authors: Khanna, Gaurav, Morales, Nicolas, Pandalai-Nayar, Nitya
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study features that supply-chains more resilient. Using new data on firm-to-firm transactions from an Indian state, we construct a firm-specific measure of upstream exposure to Covid-19 lockdowns based on pre-period purchases from affected suppliers. An event-study design shows firms with greater upstream exposure experienced higher separation rates and larger declines in real inputs and sales. However, for a given increase in upstream exposure, firms sourcing more complex inputs or inputs with fewer alternative suppliers were less likely to sever links and faced smaller production disruptions. After the shock, exposed firms adjusted, forming new links with larger, better-connected suppliers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了使供应链更具韧性的特征。利用来自印度某邦的企业间交易新数据，我们基于疫情封锁前从受影响供应商的采购情况，构建了一个企业层面的上游疫情封锁暴露度指标。事件研究设计显示，上游暴露度较高的企业经历了更高的关系断裂率，以及实际投入和销售额的更大幅度下降。然而，在给定的上游暴露度增加下，采购更复杂投入品或替代供应商较少的投入品的企业，更不可能切断联系，且面临的生产中断较小。冲击过后，受影响企业进行了调整，与规模更大、连接更广的供应商建立了新联系。

title: A Practical Review of Methods to Estimate Overcharges Using Linear Regression
title_zh: 线性回归估算超额收费方法的实用综述
title_primary: 线性回归估算超额收费方法的实用综述

authors: Roman Inderst, Christopher Milde
official: 官方在线 2022-01-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Arguably the most widely used techniques for estimating price overcharges from competition law infringements are the dummy variable and the forecasting approaches using linear regression analysis. While rarely used in practice, in this note we make use of the fully interacted dummy variable approach to review some basic properties of all three approaches. We show under which conditions and for which estimands of interest these approaches are equivalent and when they differ. We also note some interesting additional choices an interaction approach allows.
abstract_zh: 可以说，在估算竞争法侵权导致的超额价格时，最广泛使用的技术是虚拟变量法和基于线性回归分析的预测方法。尽管在实践中很少使用，但在本文中，我们利用完全交互的虚拟变量方法来审视这三种方法的一些基本特性。我们展示了在何种条件下、针对哪些感兴趣的估计目标，这些方法是等价的，以及它们何时存在差异。我们还注意到，交互方法允许一些有趣的额外选择。

title: The local and aggregate effects of land-use regulation on farmland protection
title_zh: 土地利用规制对农田保护的局部与总体效应
title_primary: 土地利用规制对农田保护的局部与总体效应
title_secondary: The local and aggregate effects of land-use regulation on farmland protection
authors: Yue Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the distortionary effects of land-use regulations that preserve farmland from urban sprawl. I exploit a major policy restricting farm-to-urban land conversion in China — the Farmland Red Line Policy — to provide causal evidence on the negative impact of land-use regulation on local development, measured by GDP and population growth. To understand the aggregate impact of the policy, I develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that features endogenous land-use decisions. The calibrated model reveals a 7% loss in workers’ welfare due to the policy. Furthermore, a cap-and-trade platform that allows local regions to exchange farmland preservation requirements can eliminate 60% of workers’ welfare costs. The results highlight the substantial welfare costs that can arise from suboptimal land-use policies, underscoring the need for careful design in fast-growing economies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在保护农田免受城市扩张影响的土地使用法规所产生的扭曲效应。我利用中国一项限制农地转用的重大政策——农田红线政策——作为自然实验，提供了土地使用法规对地方发展（以GDP和人口增长衡量）产生负面影响的因果证据。为理解该政策的总体影响，我构建了一个包含内生土地使用决策的定量空间均衡模型。校准模型显示，该政策导致工人福利损失7%。此外，一个允许各地区交易农田保护义务的总量控制与交易平台，能够消除60%的工人福利成本。研究结果凸显了次优土地使用政策可能带来的巨大福利代价，强调了在快速增长经济体中政策设计需谨慎的重要性。

title: Early Dairy Regulation: Raw Milk Laws and Child Mortality in the United States
title_zh: 美国早期乳制品监管：生乳法律与儿童死亡率
title_primary: 美国早期乳制品监管：生乳法律与儿童死亡率
title_secondary: Early Dairy Regulation: Raw Milk Laws and Child Mortality in the United States
authors: Rippley, Samantha
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines the public health impact of early dairy regulation in the United States by analyzing the relationship between raw milk laws and child mortality from 1850 to 1950. Using linked census microdata from the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series (IPUMS) full-count datasets, intercensal child mortality rates are constructed for children aged 0-5, and a staggered adoption difference-in-differences design is employed to estimate the causal effects of dairy regulations. The identification strategy exploits the heterogeneous timing of raw milk law adoption across counties, with regulations emerging in 1914. The analysis tracks approximately 54.8 million children across ten decade pairs, focusing on families with successfully linked parents to minimize measurement error in mortality estimation. Results indicate that comprehensive dairy regulations did not, on average, reduce child mortality. The preferred specification restricts estimation to individually-verified municipal ordinance counties, the jurisdictions where mandates were most plausibly binding, and is the only specification satisfying the parallel trends assumption. Remaining specifications fail the parallel trends test, consistent with positive selection of urbanizing, lower-mortality counties into treatment. The null result is consistent with voluntary pre-adoption, weak enforcement outside major cities, and declining milk-borne exposure as concurrent water infrastructure improvements reduced competing causes of child death.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过分析1850年至1950年间生奶法律与儿童死亡率之间的关系，考察了美国早期乳制品监管的公共卫生影响。利用综合公共使用微观数据系列（IPUMS）全量普查微观数据，构建了0-5岁儿童的人口普查间隔期死亡率，并采用交错采纳的双重差分设计来估计乳制品监管的因果效应。识别策略利用了各县采纳生奶法律的时间差异，相关法规于1914年开始出现。分析追踪了十个十年配对中约5480万名儿童，重点关注父母成功关联的家庭，以最小化死亡率估计中的测量误差。结果表明，全面的乳制品监管平均而言并未降低儿童死亡率。首选规格将估计限制在经个体验证的市政条例县，即法规最可能具有约束力的司法管辖区，且是唯一满足平行趋势假设的规格。其余规格均未通过平行趋势检验，这与城市化程度较高、死亡率较低的县正向选择进入处理组的情况一致。零结果与采纳前的自愿行为、主要城市以外执法力度薄弱，以及同期供水基础设施改善减少了儿童死亡竞争性原因从而降低了乳源性暴露风险的解释相一致。

title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
title_primary: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
title_secondary: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
authors: Diego Känzig, Geoffroy Dolphin, Gianluigi Ferrucci
official: 官方在线 2025-07-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征和高频数据，我识别了碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。紧缩性碳政策冲击推高能源价格，减少排放，激发绿色创新，但同时也降低了经济活动——不成比例地加重了贫困家庭的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受影响更大，还面临更大的收入损失。这些通过收入和就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中扮演重要角色，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。

title: Understanding the Impact of Multi-Nodal Urban Systems on Thailand's Urban Economies: Insights from a Dynamic Recursive Spatial General Equilibrium Model
title_zh: 多节点城市系统对泰国城市经济的影响：基于动态递归空间一般均衡模型的洞察
title_primary: 多节点城市系统对泰国城市经济的影响：基于动态递归空间一般均衡模型的洞察
title_secondary: Understanding the Impact of Multi-Nodal Urban Systems on Thailand's Urban Economies: Insights from a Dynamic Recursive Spatial General Equilibrium Model
authors: Wibisana, Putu Sanjiwacika, Rubinyi, Steven Louis
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Thailand's transition to high-income status is, at its core, an urban challenge. Bangkok generates nearly half of the national gross domestic product, yet its dominance is increasingly constrained by congestion, environmental stress, and diminishing returns to further concentration. Successive National Spatial Development Strategies have called for a more multi-nodal urban hierarchy, but the analytical basis for evaluating that ambition has remained thin. This paper builds and calibrates a Dynamic Recursive Spatial Quantitative General Equilibrium model for Thailand's urban system from 2025 to 2050, and uses it to evaluate three counterfactual policy portfolios that allocate the same aggregate productivity-investment envelope (roughly 2.3 percent of 2030 urban gross domestic product) across Bangkok and the eleven designated secondary cities in different proportions: a Bangkok-leaning portfolio (80/20), a balanced portfolio (50/50), and a secondary-leaning portfolio (20/80). The Bangkok-leaning portfolio leads through 2045, but the secondary-leaning portfolio overtakes it between 2045 and 2050, delivering a 12.38 percent gain in national gross domestic product per capita above the no-investment baseline against 11.62 percent for the Bangkok-leaning alternative. The balanced portfolio is dominated by both skewed alternatives in 2050, reflecting a threshold property of agglomeration economies. A two-dimensional envelope-by-split sweep shows that the relative ranking is genuinely contingent on the scale and horizon of the commitment: below a certain tipping point, the Bangkok-leaning portfolio dominates; above it, the secondary-leaning portfolio does. A modest, well-allocated spatial-investment program is unlikely to be the engine of Thailand's high-income transition; sufficient scale of commitment is a precondition.
abstract_zh: 泰国迈向高收入地位的转型，其核心在于城市挑战。曼谷贡献了近半数的国内生产总值，但其主导地位日益受到拥堵、环境压力及进一步集聚收益递减的制约。历次国家空间发展战略均呼吁构建更为多节点的城市层级体系，然而评估这一愿景的分析基础仍显薄弱。本文构建并校准了一个适用于泰国城市系统的动态递归空间量化一般均衡模型，时间跨度为2025年至2050年，并利用该模型评估了三种反事实政策组合，这些组合将相同的总生产率投资包（约占2030年城市国内生产总值的2.3%）按不同比例分配给曼谷及十一个指定次级城市：偏向曼谷的组合（80/20）、均衡组合（50/50）及偏向次级城市的组合（20/80）。偏向曼谷的组合在2045年前领先，但偏向次级城市的组合在2045年至2050年间超越前者，使全国人均国内生产总值较无投资基准线高出12.38%，而偏向曼谷的替代方案则为11.62%。均衡组合在2050年被两种倾斜方案所主导，这反映了集聚经济的阈值特性。二维的包络-分配扫描显示，相对排名确实取决于承诺的规模与时间跨度：低于某一临界点，偏向曼谷的组合占优；高于该临界点，则偏向次级城市的组合胜出。一个适度且配置得当的空间投资计划不太可能成为泰国高收入转型的引擎；足够的承诺规模是前提条件。

title: Biosphere Reserves as Boundary Organisations that support landscape governance: Analysing the Biosphere for Baltic network
title_zh: 生物圈保护区作为支持景观治理的边界组织：对波罗的海生物圈网络的分析
title_primary: 生物圈保护区作为支持景观治理的边界组织：对波罗的海生物圈网络的分析
title_secondary: Biosphere Reserves as Boundary Organisations that support landscape governance: Analysing the Biosphere for Baltic network
authors: Charles Westerberg, Ralph Tafon, Michael Gilek
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article analyses how Biosphere Reserves (BRs) in the Biosphere for Baltic network operate as Boundary Organisations (BOs) in support of collaborative landscape governance. Using Ostrom’s Institutional Analysis and Development framework in combination with BO theory, it examines how institutional arrangements, stakeholder interactions, and contextual conditions shape the capacity of BRs to convene, translate, collaborate, and mediate across governance levels. Based on case studies of seven BRs in the Baltic Sea region, the results show consistent patterns in how governance models, participatory processes, knowledge flows, and institutional recognition enable or constrain boundary functions. Effective convening and collaboration were most evident where long-standing relationships, strong trust, and cross-sectoral platforms were in place. Barriers arose from short-term project cycles, uneven participation, tensions around authority and role boundaries, and limited national-level uptake of BR-generated knowledge. Knowledge translation appeared stronger when BRs could connect scientific, local, and administrative perspectives and relate them to planning and management needs, while institutional misalignment made learning and follow-up more difficult. The findings underscore the need to balance institutional flexibility, neutrality, learning, and embeddedness to enhance the effectiveness of BRs as boundary organisations for advancing landscape governance.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了“波罗的海生物圈网络”中的生物圈保护区如何作为边界组织运作，以支持协作式景观治理。结合奥斯特罗姆的制度分析与发展框架与边界组织理论，探讨了制度安排、利益相关者互动及情境条件如何塑造生物圈保护区在治理层级间召集、翻译、协作与调解的能力。基于波罗的海地区七个生物圈保护区的案例研究，结果显示治理模式、参与过程、知识流动及制度认可在促进或制约边界功能方面呈现出一致规律。在长期关系、高度信任及跨部门平台已建立的地区，有效的召集与协作最为显著。障碍则源于短期项目周期、参与不均衡、权威与角色边界的张力，以及国家层面对生物圈保护区所产生知识的采纳有限。当生物圈保护区能够连接科学、地方与行政视角，并将其与规划管理需求相关联时，知识翻译能力更强；而制度错位则使学习与后续跟进更为困难。研究结果强调，需平衡制度灵活性、中立性、学习能力与嵌入性，以提升生物圈保护区作为边界组织在推进景观治理中的有效性。

title: Toward a responsibility system in China’s community carbon forestry management: A practice based on ordered polycentric governance
title_zh: 中国社区碳汇林管理中的责任体系构建：基于有序多中心治理的实践
title_primary: 中国社区碳汇林管理中的责任体系构建：基于有序多中心治理的实践
title_secondary: Toward a responsibility system in China’s community carbon forestry management: A practice based on ordered polycentric governance
authors: Bohao Jin, Yanqiang Du, Xianlei Ma
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Balancing carbon reduction and local livelihoods has remained a persistent challenge in community carbon forestry management (CCFM). Current literature is increasingly acknowledging the need to reconcile individual and collective objectives in CCFM based on Ostromian polycentricity, yet it has not identified an optimal solution. We develop a “agency relationship-motivation strategy-property rights structure-outcomes” framework to unpack the responsibility system in China’s CCFM. Within this analytical framework, we first classify three forms of principal-agent relationships alongside their matching incentive strategies. Second, we unpack the interconnections among principal-agent relationships, motivation strategies, and property rights allocation. Finally, we argue that CCFM exhibits an ordered polycentric governance structure. Further, we apply the analytical framework to the CCFM case in Shunchang, Fujian, China, and find that: (i) three types of agency relationships in CCFM, i.e., delegation, administrative commission, and civil commission, match the intensity of the three motivation strategies (political incentives, economic incentives, and intrinsic incentives). (ii) agency relationships and motivation strategies jointly shape the property rights structure, e.g., principals under delegation possess authoritative rights; agents under delegation and principals under administrative commission exercise control rights; agents under administrative and civil commission exercise use rights. (iii) the effective integration of multiple principal-agent relationships shapes the ordered polycentric governance in China’s CCFM. The delegation addresses spatial integration challenges, and responds to political promotion demands; the administrative commission tackles institutional innovation dilemmas; the civil commission copes with social network extension issues. The analysis of CCFM within the Chinese context contributes to debates on the role of rural carbon forestry management in and beyond China.
abstract_zh: 平衡碳减排与地方生计一直是社区碳汇林业管理（CCFM）中的持续挑战。现有文献日益认识到，基于奥斯特罗姆式多中心理论，在CCFM中协调个体与集体目标之必要性，然而尚未找到最优解。我们构建了一个“委托代理关系—激励策略—产权结构—结果”的分析框架，以解析中国CCFM中的责任体系。在此分析框架内，我们首先将委托代理关系划分为三种形式，并匹配相应的激励策略。其次，我们揭示委托代理关系、激励策略与产权配置之间的内在联系。最后，我们认为CCFM呈现出有序的多中心治理结构。进一步地，我们将该分析框架应用于中国福建顺昌的CCFM案例，发现：（i）CCFM中的三类代理关系，即委托、行政委托和民事委托，与三种激励策略（政治激励、经济激励和内在激励）的强度相匹配。（ii）委托代理关系与激励策略共同塑造产权结构，例如，委托关系下的委托人拥有权威性权利；委托关系下的代理人和行政委托关系下的委托人行使控制权；行政委托和民事委托关系下的代理人行使使用权。（iii）多种委托代理关系的有效整合塑造了中国CCFM中的有序多中心治理。委托关系解决了空间整合挑战，并回应了政治晋升需求；行政委托应对了制度创新困境；民事委托处理了社会网络扩展问题。在中国语境下对CCFM的分析，为国内外农村碳汇林业管理作用的讨论作出了贡献。

title: Import tariff transmission in a production network

official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We find that whether US import tariffs have supply-side effects or demand-side effects on US manufacturing sectors depends on where the affected sectors are located in the US production network. Using local projections in a panel of US manufacturing sectors, we find that US import tariffs —including the 2018-19 tariff hikes— led to sectoral output contractions via two different channels: (1) Tariff increases act as negative supply shifters for sectors that use goods from tariff-facing sectors as input in production and thus face rising input costs. (2) Tariff increases act as negative demand shifters for sectors whose customer sectors suffer negative supply side effects due to tariffs and reduce their production. We show that these results are consistent with a stylized production network model featuring complementarities in production. Overall, our finding suggests that tariffs markedly reduce US manufacturing production and that the role of input–output linkages is key for understanding the transmission of import tariff shocks to output and producer prices. abstract_zh: 我们发现，美国进口关税对美国制造业部门的影响究竟是供给侧效应还是需求侧效应，取决于受影响部门在美国生产网络中的位置。基于美国制造业部门面板数据的局部投影法分析表明，美国进口关税（包括2018-2019年的关税上调）通过两种不同渠道导致部门产出收缩：（1）关税上调对使用受关税影响部门产品作为生产投入的部门构成负向供给冲击，使其面临投入成本上升；（2）关税上调对客户部门因关税遭受负向供给冲击而缩减生产的部门构成负向需求冲击。我们证明，这些结果与一个包含生产互补性的简化生产网络模型一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明关税显著抑制了美国制造业产出，而投入产出关联在理解进口关税冲击向产出和生产者价格传导的过程中起着关键作用。JEL分类号：E23, E32, F13

abstract: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries, and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost-of-living inequality and long-run growth.
abstract_zh: 创新职业机会的不平等对创新方向与不平等有何影响？利用美国和芬兰的新型关联数据集，我们证实创新者更倾向于开发与其自身在性别、社会经济地位及年龄方面相似的消费者更可能购买的产品。这种同质性既存在于细分产品类别内部，也跨越不同行业，且近几十年来保持稳定。通过将这一"社会推动"渠道纳入增长模型，我们估算出创新职业机会的不平等对生活成本不平等及长期增长具有显著影响。

abstract: Financial crimes are costly to society but less severely punished than other nonviolent crimes. We investigate whether prison sentences reduce financial crimes. Using random assignment of judges in Finland to identify causal impacts, we find a prison sentence reduces defendant reoffending by 42.9 percentage points three years postsentencing. Given prior evidence of financial misconduct “contagion,” we also explore spillovers on colleagues. A prison sentence reduces the likelihood that a financial crime defendant’s colleagues commit crimes by 27 percentage points, suggesting broader deterrent effects of harsher punishments, but only for fraud cases. Last, we show financial crimes are not victimless crimes. (JEL K14, K22, K41, K42)
abstract_zh: 金融犯罪对社会造成高昂代价，但相较于其他非暴力犯罪，其惩罚力度较轻。本文探究监禁刑罚能否减少金融犯罪。利用芬兰法官随机分配机制识别因果效应，我们发现，判决监禁使被告在判决后三年内的再犯率降低42.9个百分点。鉴于已有证据表明金融不当行为具有"传染性"，我们进一步考察了对同事的溢出效应。监禁判决使金融犯罪被告同事的犯罪概率降低27个百分点，这表明更严厉的惩罚具有更广泛的威慑效应，但该效应仅存在于欺诈案件中。最后，我们证明金融犯罪并非无受害者的犯罪。（JEL K14, K22, K41, K42）

title: Measuring Sensitive Outcomes through Ballot-Bag Surveys
title_zh: 通过投票袋调查测量敏感结果

official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Prevailing methods for measuring sensitive outcomes confront researchers with an inherent bias-variance trade-off: direct questioning is prone to a sensitivity bias, while indirect methods such as list experiments are substantially less precise. We test the ballot-bag, a novel technique that relaxes this trade-off by mitigating bias in direct questioning while improving precision over indirect methods. In an experiment in Egypt, where direct questions on irregular migration are biased, ballot-bag estimates are not statistically different from those from a list experiment but exhibit significantly lower variance. Consequently, treatment effects are highly significant via the ballot-bag and not via the list experiment.
abstract_zh: 当前测量敏感结果的主流方法使研究者面临固有的偏差-方差权衡：直接提问易产生敏感性偏差，而列举实验等间接方法则精度显著不足。我们测试了"投票袋"这一新技术，该技术通过减轻直接提问中的偏差并提升间接方法的精度来缓解这一权衡。在埃及的一项实验中，针对非正规移民的直接提问存在偏差，而投票袋估计值与列举实验的结果无统计差异，但方差显著更低。因此，通过投票袋方法得出的处理效应高度显著，而列举实验则未呈现此结果。

title: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations
title_zh: 加纳大塔马利地区城市绿地转型的政治生态学：条件、驱动因素与权力关系
title_primary: 加纳大塔马利地区城市绿地转型的政治生态学：条件、驱动因素与权力关系
title_secondary: The political ecology of urban green space transformation in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Conditions, drivers, and power relations
authors: Abdulai Abdul-Hamid, Asiama Kwabena Obeng, Frank Gyamfi-Yeboah, Ibrahim Yakubu, Dogkubong Dinye Romanus
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) are critical for ecological sustainability, social wellbeing, public health, and urban livability, yet they are increasingly threatened in rapidly urbanising cities. This study employed a qualitative case study approach to examine the condition of urban green spaces and the socio-ecological and governance processes driving their decline in five communities within the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area (GTMA): Gumbehene, Nyohini, Kukuo, Taha, and Sagnarigu. Data were collected through in-depth semi-structured interviews with residents, community leaders, planning officials, landowners, and other stakeholders involved in land governance, complemented by field observations of green space distribution, quality, accessibility, and use. The data were analysed thematically through systematic coding and categorisation of interview transcripts and field notes to identify recurring patterns, key drivers, and governance challenges associated with green space decline. The findings reveal significant deterioration of UGSs, characterised by inadequate provision, poor maintenance, safety concerns, and increasing inaccessibility. This decline is driven by interconnected factors, including rapid population growth and horizontal urban expansion into green and open spaces, the commercialisation of customary land, weak planning enforcement, fragmented institutional responsibilities, and political interference. Together, these processes prioritise short-term economic and political interests over long-term ecological sustainability and community wellbeing, resulting in inequitable access to green spaces and the gradual erosion of their ecological, social, and public health functions. By foregrounding local perspectives and lived experiences, the study offers actionable insights for promoting sustainable, resilient, and inclusive urban planning and green space governance in the GTMA and other rapidly urbanising contexts facing similar challenges.
abstract_zh: 城市绿色空间（UGS）对生态可持续性、社会福祉、公共健康及城市宜居性至关重要，然而在快速城市化的城市中，它们正日益受到威胁。本研究采用定性案例研究方法，考察了大塔马利都市区（GTMA）内五个社区（古姆贝赫内、尼约希尼、库库奥、塔哈和萨格纳里古）城市绿色空间的状况及其衰退背后的社会生态与治理过程。数据通过深入半结构化访谈收集，访谈对象包括居民、社区领袖、规划官员、土地所有者及其他参与土地治理的利益相关者，并辅以对绿色空间分布、质量、可达性和使用情况的实地观察。数据通过系统编码和分类访谈记录及实地笔记进行主题分析，以识别与绿色空间衰退相关的重复模式、关键驱动因素和治理挑战。研究结果揭示了城市绿色空间的显著退化，表现为供给不足、维护不善、安全隐患及可达性日益降低。这一衰退由相互关联的因素驱动，包括人口快速增长和水平城市扩张侵占绿色及开放空间、习惯土地的商品化、规划执法薄弱、机构职责分散以及政治干预。这些过程共同将短期经济和政治利益置于长期生态可持续性和社区福祉之上，导致绿色空间获取的不平等以及其生态、社会和公共健康功能的逐步侵蚀。通过突出地方视角和生活经验，本研究为促进GTMA及其他面临类似挑战的快速城市化背景下可持续、有韧性和包容性的城市规划及绿色空间治理提供了可操作的见解。

title: Forest livelihood strategies under contrasting management regimes: Evidence from the Copperbelt, Eastern and North-Western Provinces of Zambia

authors: Moses Kazungu, Sven Günter, Gillian Kabwe

abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。

abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, women constitute the majority of new Christian membership (including Evangelical and Pentecostal denominations), and this gender gap exceeds that of any other religion. Existing explanations for conversion to these churches emphasize demand for mutual help or informal insurance. We instead show that emancipation is central: these churches provide services that support women's economic advancement and help them challenge patriarchal norms. Using experimental data from Benin, we find that women randomly offered an economic opportunity become more likely to convert, partly because these churches help counter witchcraft threats, a risk that disproportionately targets economically successful women. To assess external validity, we combine large African datasets with local variation in exposure to positive economic shocks - using exogenous changes in cash crop prices and the implementation of world bank projects with a gender focus. Women are more likely to join new Christian churches following such shocks, especially where witchcraft beliefs are widespread. There, women work more, have fewer children, and exercise greater decisionâ€‘making power, while both women and men reject traditional beliefs, rituals, and authorities.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性构成了新兴基督教教会（包括福音派和五旬节派）新信徒的主体，这一性别差距超过任何其他宗教。现有对改信这些教会的解释强调对互助或非正式保险的需求。然而，我们证明解放是核心因素：这些教会提供支持女性经济进步并帮助她们挑战父权规范的服务。利用贝宁的实验数据，我们发现，随机获得经济机会的女性更可能改信，部分原因在于这些教会帮助对抗巫术威胁——这种风险不成比例地针对经济成功的女性。为评估外部有效性，我们将大型非洲数据集与正向经济冲击的局部暴露变化相结合——利用经济作物价格的外生变化以及以性别为重点的世界银行项目的实施。女性在经历此类冲击后更可能加入新兴基督教教会，尤其是在巫术信仰普遍的地区。在那里，女性工作更多、生育更少、拥有更大的决策权，同时女性和男性都摒弃传统信仰、仪式和权威。

title: Academic and health outcomes of online education for primary and secondary students: Evidence from COVID-19
title_zh: 中小学在线教育的学业与健康结果：来自COVID-19的证据

authors: Yueqin Wang, Chuanchuan Zhang, Junsen Zhang
official: 来源期次 2026-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Online education is rapidly expanding due to technological advancements and increased demand for quality education. However, its effectiveness and impact on student behavior are not well understood. The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated online education and offered a unique opportunity to evaluate its effects. Using nationwide longitudinal survey data from China, we find that online education during the pandemic significantly diminished academic performance and worsened mental health outcomes, including increased depressive symptoms and decreased well-being. Our analysis explores four behavioral mechanisms: interpersonal needs and relationships, parent-child interactions, teacher-student dynamics, and time allocation. We demonstrate that online education reduces effective peer interaction, deteriorates self-reported interpersonal and familial relationships, and leads to inefficient time allocation. Students also substantially increased their entertainment internet use, including video watching and gaming. These factors contributed to declines in academic performance and mental health. Our findings underscore the critical role of social networks and time allocation in maximizing the benefits of online education.
abstract_zh: 在线教育因技术进步和对优质教育需求的增长而迅速扩张。然而，其有效性及对学生行为的影响尚不明确。新冠疫情加速了在线教育的普及，为评估其效果提供了独特契机。利用中国全国范围的纵向调查数据，我们发现疫情期间的在线教育显著降低了学业表现，并恶化了心理健康结果，包括抑郁症状增加和幸福感下降。我们的分析探讨了四种行为机制：人际需求与关系、亲子互动、师生动态以及时间分配。研究表明，在线教育减少了有效的同伴互动，恶化了自报的人际关系和家庭关系，并导致时间分配效率低下。学生娱乐性互联网使用也大幅增加，包括观看视频和玩游戏。这些因素共同导致了学业表现和心理健康的下降。我们的发现强调了社交网络和时间分配在最大化在线教育效益中的关键作用。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Personalized recommendation systems shape much of user choice online, yet their targeted nature makes separating out the value of recommendation and the underlying goods challenging. We build a discrete-choice model that embeds recommendation-induced utility, low-rank heterogeneity, and flexible state dependence and apply the model to viewership data at Netflix. We identify recommendation-induced engagement from observational variation in algorithmic exposure, treating exposure as conditionally exogenous given observed user, good, and state characteristics. Separately, we estimate model-free diversion ratios from a randomized experiment that perturbs recommendations and use these to assess the validity of the structural model. We use the model to evaluate counterfactuals that quantify the incremental engagement generated by personalized recommendations. First, we show that replacing the current recommender system with a matrix factorization or popularity-based algorithm would lead to a 4% and 12% reduction in engagement, respectively, and decreased consumption diversity. Second, most of the consumption increase from recommendations comes from effective targeting, not mechanical exposure, with the largest gains for mid-popularity goods (as opposed to broadly appealing or very niche goods).
abstract_zh: 个性化推荐系统在很大程度上塑造了用户的在线选择，但其针对性特征使得分离推荐本身的价值与所推荐商品的价值颇具挑战。我们构建了一个离散选择模型，该模型融合了推荐引致的效用、低秩异质性以及灵活的状态依赖性，并将此模型应用于Netflix的观看数据。我们通过算法曝光中的观测变异来识别推荐引致的参与度，将曝光视为在给定观测到的用户、商品及状态特征条件下的条件外生变量。此外，我们利用一项随机实验来估计无模型依赖的转移比率，该实验对推荐进行扰动，并以此评估结构模型的有效性。我们运用该模型评估反事实情境，量化个性化推荐所产生的增量参与度。首先，我们表明，若将当前推荐系统替换为矩阵分解或基于流行度的算法，参与度将分别下降4%和12%，且消费多样性也会降低。其次，推荐带来的消费增长大部分源于有效的目标定位，而非机械性曝光，其中中等流行度商品（相对于广泛吸引力或极为小众的商品）获益最大。

abstract: This study examines the relationship between institution-level intercollegiate athletic success and the academic quality of incoming freshmen classes at U.S. universities. abstract: We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, , the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times . When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by . Unlike prior measures, is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.

abstract: This paper studies tax policy interaction among local governments for both mobile and immobile tax bases. We exploit exogenous changes in the local tax setting of German municipalities due to participation in state debt reduction programs to learn about the size, scope and nature of strategic interaction among local governments. Our results suggest strong and significant tax policy responses both in corporate as well as in property tax rates. Based on these results, the tax response function gradients are in the range of 0.30 to 0.69, depending on the tax instrument and state. Spatial, political, demographic, and administrative municipality characteristics all influence the size of the tax response.

title: Can Extensive Grassland Management Pay Off for Farmers Facing Drought Risks? A Cumulative Prospect Theory‐Based Approach

abstract: ABSTRACT Grasslands in Central Europe are increasingly affected by droughts, leading to lower hay yields and reduced profits for dairy farmers. The insurance hypothesis suggests that extensively managed, species‐rich grassland is more drought resistant than intensively managed grassland. However, it produces lower yields in non‐drought years, creating a trade‐off between maximising yield and improving stability. In this study, we analyse how this trade‐off translates into farmers' management decisions. Using a mechanistic bio‐economic model, we evaluate outcomes across a wide range of simulated ecological, climatic and economic input conditions. We apply classification tree analysis to identify key drivers of extensive management under expected utility, cumulative prospect theory and an extension we call reference‐based valuation, where outcomes are valued relative to management‐specific expectations. Results suggest that farmers who evaluate profits against the expected outcome under each management intensity potentially adopt extensive management despite lower expected profit if it offers greater stability during droughts. By contrast, when outcomes are compared to the status quo of intensive management, or when farmers maximise utility, extensive management is only predicted if foregone yields do not outweigh higher drought stability. Our findings highlight that adoption decisions depend strongly on the valuation perspective, motivating further applications of reference‐based behavioural models and research on how farmers' reference profits might evolve under climate change. They also suggest policy entry points: targeted extension services and demonstration farms could broaden evaluation perspectives, while financial incentives such as payments for ecosystem services could reduce adoption thresholds due to forgone yields under profit‐oriented decision‐making.
abstract_zh: 摘要 中欧的草原日益受到干旱影响，导致干草产量下降，奶农利润减少。保险假说认为，粗放管理、物种丰富的草原比集约管理的草原更具抗旱性。然而，在非干旱年份其产量较低，从而在最大化产量与提升稳定性之间形成权衡。本研究分析了这一权衡如何转化为农户的管理决策。我们采用机制性生物经济模型，在广泛的模拟生态、气候和经济输入条件下评估结果。我们应用分类树分析，识别在期望效用、累积前景理论以及我们称之为基于参考估值（即结果相对于各管理方式特定预期进行评价）的扩展框架下粗放管理的关键驱动因素。结果表明，若农户将利润与每种管理强度下的预期结果进行比较，即使预期利润较低，也可能因粗放管理在干旱期间提供更高稳定性而采纳该方式。相比之下，当结果与集约管理的现状进行比较，或农户追求效用最大化时，仅当放弃的产量不超过更高的干旱稳定性时，才预测会采纳粗放管理。我们的发现强调，采纳决策强烈依赖于估值视角，这激励了基于参考的行为模型的进一步应用，以及关于气候变化下农户参考利润可能如何演变的研究。这些发现还提示了政策切入点：针对性的推广服务和示范农场可拓宽评估视角，而生态系统服务付费等财政激励可在利润导向决策下降低因放弃产量而产生的采纳门槛。

abstract: ABSTRACT Agricultural methane emissions represent a significant contributor to global climate change, with irrigated rice cultivation being one of the primary sources. Despite the availability of effective mitigation technologies, their adoption often remains limited due to behavioural and institutional constraints. Water management practice that extends drainage periods during cultivation can curb methane emissions from irrigated rice at low cost, yet uptake among Japanese farmers remains modest. We surveyed 2219 rice producers in Shiga Prefecture using a labelled choice experiment that embedded two behavioural nudges (social norm and loss aversion) and one informational boost (knowledge enhancement), presented with or without a reminder. Farmers most favoured a 7‐day drainage extension. Social‐norm messages did not robustly shift adoption intentions, but loss‐aversion and knowledge enhancement paired with reminders increased the probability of choosing water management practice by 5–10 percentage points, particularly when financial incentives were modest. The added value of nudges and boosts faded once subsidies approached prevailing ceiling levels, suggesting diminishing marginal returns to stacking instruments. These findings suggest that timely, low‐cost behavioural interventions can effectively complement agri‐environmental payments in resource‐constrained settings, providing a scalable and context‐sensitive strategy to accelerate the adoption of climate‐smart rice practices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农业甲烷排放是全球气候变化的重要贡献因素，其中灌溉水稻种植是主要排放源之一。尽管存在有效的减排技术，但由于行为与制度约束，其采用率往往有限。在种植期间延长排水期的水分管理实践能够以低成本减少灌溉水稻的甲烷排放，然而日本农户的采纳率仍然不高。我们对滋贺县2219名水稻生产者开展了一项标注选择实验，其中嵌入了两种行为助推（社会规范与损失厌恶）和一种信息增强（知识提升），并设置有无提醒的呈现方式。农户最偏好延长排水7天的方案。社会规范信息未能稳健地改变采纳意愿，但损失厌恶和知识提升配合提醒措施，将选择水分管理实践的概率提高了5至10个百分点，尤其在经济激励较为有限时效果显著。当补贴接近现行上限水平时，助推与增强措施的附加价值逐渐消失，表明叠加干预工具的边际回报递减。这些发现表明，及时且低成本的行为干预能够在资源受限环境中有效补充农业环境支付，提供一种可扩展且情境敏感的策略，以加速气候智能型水稻实践的采纳。

abstract: This paper develops a competitive search model with asymmetric information and argues that small firms hold liquid assets not only to self-finance their investments but also to signal their investment quality, thereby obtaining better loan terms. Because self-finance is an outside option of borrowing, it affects bank loans and the credit market structure. Monetary policy affects the cost of self-finance and hence affects the market structure and the screening regimes in the credit market. An increase in the policy rate can trigger banks to use screening contracts, which distort allocations. Using U.S. data, I document that dispersion in firms’ cash-to-asset ratios is hump-shaped in policy rates, consistent with the model’s prediction that firms use liquidity holdings to signal.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含信息不对称的竞争性搜索模型，并论证小企业持有流动资产不仅是为了自我融资其投资，也是为了传递其投资质量的信号，从而获得更优的贷款条件。由于自我融资是借款的外部选择，它影响银行贷款和信贷市场结构。货币政策影响自我融资的成本，进而影响信贷市场的市场结构和筛选机制。政策利率的上升可能促使银行采用筛选合同，这会扭曲资源配置。利用美国数据，我记录了企业现金资产比率的离散度在政策利率上呈驼峰形分布，这与模型预测的企业利用流动性持有进行信号传递相一致。

abstract: We study how poor hand-to-mouth and wealthy hand-to-mouth households in the United States form their expectations as compared to unconstrained households. To do so, we use monthly household data for the period 2005:2 to 2013:6 with information on the exact survey day for each household within a month. Utilizing a timeline of financial crisis events along with changes in stock market values and uncertainty in the days around those events, we assess the response of these households' expectations regarding inflation, unemployment, and the interest rate. Our estimates imply differences in the formation of expectations for liquidity-constrained households relative to unconstrained households. Wealthy hand-to-mouth households tend to revise their inflation expectations downwards substantially so that they make lower forecast errors following adverse financial crisis events that lower the actual future inflation rate, while other households appear inattentive to these shocks. This suggests that the wealthy hand-to-mouth households decipher these financial events' noisy signal regarding lower future inflation more accurately than other households, in line with having a greater incentive to do so.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国贫困手口相济家庭与富裕手口相济家庭在形成预期时，相较于无约束家庭有何不同。为此，我们使用了2005年2月至2013年6月期间的月度家庭数据，其中包含每户家庭在月内具体调查日的信息。利用金融危机事件的时间线，以及这些事件前后几天内股市价值变化和不确定性，我们评估了这些家庭对通胀、失业率和利率预期的反应。我们的估计结果显示，流动性受限家庭与无约束家庭在预期形成上存在差异。富裕手口相济家庭倾向于大幅下调其通胀预期，从而在不利金融危机事件导致实际未来通胀率下降时，产生较低的预测误差，而其他家庭似乎对这些冲击不够关注。这表明，富裕手口相济家庭能比其他家庭更准确地解读这些金融事件中关于未来通胀下降的噪声信号，这与他们拥有更强的动机去这样做相符。

abstract: Asymmetric punishment of partners in crime, intended to incentivize whistle-blowing, may increase detection and deterrence. The idea is age-old but its use against corruption is not frequent. We study a 1997 Chinese reform that strengthened such asymmetries for some forms of bribery. Using a game-theoretic model and prosecution data, we show that combining leniency for both bribe-givers and bribe-takers can backfire by weakening incentives to report, and document a sharp decline in corruption prosecutions after the reform. Our findings suggest that the reform may have reflected increased tolerance for small bribes, and draw lessons for the design of anti-corruption policies.
abstract_zh: 旨在激励举报的犯罪同伙不对称惩罚，可能提升侦查与威慑效果。这一理念由来已久，但在反腐败中的应用并不常见。我们研究了中国1997年的一项改革，该改革强化了某些贿赂形式中的此类不对称性。通过博弈论模型与起诉数据，我们证明，对行贿者与受贿者同时给予宽大处理，可能因削弱举报激励而适得其反，并记录了改革后腐败起诉案件的显著下降。我们的发现表明，该改革可能反映了对小型贿赂容忍度的提升，并为反腐败政策的设计提供了借鉴。

title: Negative externalities of temporary reductions in cognition: Evidence from particulate matter pollution and fatal car crashes
title_zh: 认知暂时下降的负外部性：来自颗粒物污染与致命车祸的证据
title_primary: 认知暂时下降的负外部性：来自颗粒物污染与致命车祸的证据
title_secondary: Negative externalities of temporary reductions in cognition: Evidence from particulate matter pollution and fatal car crashes
authors: Anne M. Burton, Travis Roach
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mounting causal evidence shows particulate matter pollution reduces real-time cognitive function and increases aggressive behavior by reducing neural connectivity through oxidative stress and neuro-inflammation. We investigate a setting in which reduced cognition can generate significant private and external costs: driving. Using exogenous variation in wind direction, we show that a one-unit increase in PM 2.5 exposure results in just under a one-percent increase in fatal car crashes and fatalities. Further, these effects are limited to same-day pollution exposure, highlighting the immediate negative effects of high-pollution days. An across-the-board one standard deviation reduction in fine particulate matter pollution would have averted nearly 2000 motor vehicle fatalities in 2019.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的因果证据表明，颗粒物污染通过氧化应激和神经炎症降低神经连接性，从而削弱实时认知功能并增加攻击性行为。我们研究了一个认知能力下降可能产生显著私人及外部成本的场景：驾驶。利用风向的外生变化，我们发现PM 2.5暴露每增加一个单位，会导致致命车祸及死亡人数增加近百分之一。此外，这些影响仅限于当日污染暴露，凸显了高污染日的即时负面效应。若全面降低细颗粒物污染一个标准差，2019年本可避免近2000起机动车死亡事故。

title: Relationship stability: evidence from labor and marriage markets
title_zh: 关系稳定性：来自劳动力市场与婚姻市场的证据
title_primary: 关系稳定性：来自劳动力市场与婚姻市场的证据
title_secondary: Relationship stability: evidence from labor and marriage markets
authors: Iris Kesternich, Bettina Siflinger, James P. Smith, Franziska Valder
official: 官方在线 2025-11-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on a sample of elderly individuals from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe, we investigate the relationship between job and marital stability over the life cycle. We argue that an unobserved, time-varying social skill affects stability in both markets. Using a grouped fixed-effects estimator, we show that unobserved relationship stability in both markets is significantly and positively associated. Instability in both markets is associated with lower levels of trust and conscientiousness, and higher levels of extraversion and neuroticism. The absence of the father during childhood perpetuates higher instability later in life. Higher instability is also costly as it is associated with lower levels of late-life well-being.
abstract_zh: 基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查中老年个体的样本，我们考察了生命周期中职业与婚姻稳定性的关系。我们认为，一种未被观测到的、随时间变化的社会技能影响着两个市场的稳定性。采用分组固定效应估计方法，我们发现在两个市场中，未被观测到的关系稳定性之间存在显著的正向关联。两个市场中的不稳定性与较低的信任度和尽责性，以及较高的外向性和神经质水平相关。童年时期父亲的缺失会加剧晚年生活中的更高不稳定性。更高的不稳定性代价高昂，因为它与晚年福祉水平较低相关联。

title: How does the green credit interest subsidy policy affect corporate green innovation? Evidence from China
title_zh: 绿色信贷贴息政策如何影响企业绿色创新？——来自中国的证据
title_primary: 绿色信贷贴息政策如何影响企业绿色创新？——来自中国的证据
title_secondary: How does the green credit interest subsidy policy affect corporate green innovation? Evidence from China
authors: simiao song, Guanghui Cui
official: 官方在线 2025-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the effect of the Green Credit Interest Subsidy Policy (GCISP) on corporate green innovation. Drawing on a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2023, it employs a staggered difference-in-differences methodology. The findings reveal that the implementation of the GCISP led to a 7.67% increase in total green patent applications and an 11.81% rise in green invention patent applications, relative to the respective sample means. Notably, the policy’s effect is particularly salient among high-pollution enterprises in contrast to their less-polluting counterparts. Mechanism analyses further demonstrate that the GCISP stimulates green innovation primarily through reducing agency costs and alleviating financing constraints. The policy’s positive influence is most evident in regions characterized by stricter environmental regulations, and stronger intellectual property protection. Collectively, these findings provide robust evidence of the GCISP’s efficacy in facilitating corporate green innovation and yield important implications for the design and optimization of environmental policy frameworks in emerging market economies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了绿色信贷贴息政策（GCISP）对企业绿色创新的影响。基于2007至2023年中国A股上市公司样本，采用交错双重差分法进行分析。研究发现，GCISP的实施使绿色专利申请总量较样本均值增加7.67%，绿色发明专利申请量提升11.81%。值得注意的是，该政策对高污染企业的促进效应显著强于低污染企业。机制分析表明，GCISP主要通过降低代理成本与缓解融资约束来驱动绿色创新。在环境规制更严格、知识产权保护更强的地区，政策正向效应尤为突出。综合而言，这些发现为GCISP促进企业绿色创新的有效性提供了有力证据，并对新兴市场经济体环境政策框架的设计与优化具有重要启示。

title: Are China’s green stocks the safe haven? Evidence from geopolitical risks and oil prices
title_zh: 中国绿色股票是避险资产吗？来自地缘政治风险与油价的证据
title_primary: 中国绿色股票是避险资产吗？来自地缘政治风险与油价的证据
title_secondary: Are China’s green stocks the safe haven? Evidence from geopolitical risks and oil prices
authors: Yulu Yan Jinghao Li Cheng Li School of Economics and Management, Tiangong University, Tianjin, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the safe haven properties of China’s green stocks under geopolitical risks and oil market volatility. Leveraging an integrated analytical framework – including the Transformer-DCC-GARCH, SVAR, and TVP-VAR models – we examine the dynamic relationships among green stocks, geopolitical risks, and oil prices. The results show that green stocks exhibit a significant negative correlation with oil prices during periods of heightened geopolitical risks, such as the global oil price collapse, COVID-19 pandemic, and Russia-Ukraine conflict, indicating their short-term dynamic safe haven properties. Moreover, green stocks help stabilize oil price fluctuations by promoting energy transition, thereby indirectly mitigating the adverse impact of geopolitical risks and exhibiting long-term structural safe haven properties. These safe haven properties are time-varying and more pronounced during periods of heightened global risk. Further analysis demonstrates that incorporating green stocks into energy investment portfolios through a geopolitical risk-based strategy improves both return and risk-adjusted performance, confirming their practical hedging value. Overall, the findings suggest that while green stocks play a vital role in stabilizing energy markets, their hedging effectiveness is contingent on evolving risk environments. Strengthening regulatory support and expanding green financial instruments are essential to fully realize their safe haven properties.
abstract_zh: 本文探究中国绿色股票在地缘政治风险与石油市场波动下的避险属性。通过整合Transformer-DCC-GARCH、SVAR与TVP-VAR模型构建分析框架，我们考察了绿色股票、地缘政治风险与石油价格之间的动态关系。研究结果表明：在全球油价暴跌、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突等地缘政治风险加剧时期，绿色股票与石油价格呈现显著负相关，表明其具有短期动态避险属性。此外，绿色股票通过推动能源转型有助于稳定油价波动，从而间接缓解地缘政治风险的不利影响，展现出长期结构性避险属性。这些避险属性具有时变性，在全球风险加剧时期更为显著。进一步分析表明，基于地缘政治风险策略将绿色股票纳入能源投资组合，能够同时提升收益与风险调整后绩效，证实了其实际对冲价值。总体而言，研究结果表明绿色股票在稳定能源市场方面发挥重要作用，但其对冲效果取决于风险环境的演变。为充分实现其避险属性，需加强监管支持并拓展绿色金融工具。

title: Stock-market responses, oil-price dynamics, and geopolitical risk in the MEA region
title_zh: 中东与非洲地区股市反应、油价动态与地缘政治风险
title_primary: 中东与非洲地区股市反应、油价动态与地缘政治风险
title_secondary: Stock-market responses, oil-price dynamics, and geopolitical risk in the MEA region
authors: Mohamed Abdelaziz Eissa Hisham Al Refai Georgios Chortareas a Department of Finance and Economics, College of Business and Economics, Qatar University, Doha, Qatarb King’s Business School, King’s College London, London, UK
official: 官方在线 2025-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the symmetric and asymmetric effects of oil-price shocks and geopolitical risk (GPR) on the stock-market performance of six Middle Eastern and African economies during the period 2002–2023, utilizing the nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag (NARDL) framework. Our findings underscore the necessity of accounting for country-specific characteristics, as each market demonstrates distinct sensitivities and dynamic responses to these factors. Stock markets in Egypt, Tunisia, and Turkey are significantly influenced by both oil prices and GPR, exhibiting asymmetric long-run effects. The stock markets in Saudi Arabia and Israel respond positively to oil-price changes and display resilience to GPR, while South Africa’s market demonstrates resilience and adaptability to both factors, in the long and short run. We highlight the implications of identifying the distinct sensitivities to major external shocks (geopolitical and oil-price shocks) as a prerequisite for designing financial policies at the country level. These findings offer practical guidance for policymakers to implement country-specific risk management frameworks, enhance market resilience, and tailor regulatory responses to external shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用非线性自回归分布滞后（NARDL）框架，考察了2002年至2023年间石油价格冲击与地缘政治风险（GPR）对六个中东和非洲经济体股市表现的影响，包括对称与非对称效应。研究发现，必须考虑各国特有的特征，因为每个市场对这些因素表现出不同的敏感性和动态响应。埃及、突尼斯和土耳其的股市显著受到石油价格和地缘政治风险的影响，并展现出长期非对称效应。沙特阿拉伯和以色列的股市对石油价格变化呈正向反应，并对地缘政治风险表现出韧性，而南非的股市在长期和短期内均展现出对这两类因素的韧性和适应性。我们强调识别对重大外部冲击（地缘政治和石油价格冲击）的独特敏感性，是制定国家层面金融政策的前提条件。这些发现为政策制定者提供了实践指导，以实施针对国别的风险管理框架，增强市场韧性，并针对外部冲击调整监管应对措施。

title: Heterogeneous preferences, spousal interaction, and couples' time-use
title_zh: 异质性偏好、配偶互动与夫妻时间利用
title_primary: 异质性偏好、配偶互动与夫妻时间利用
title_secondary: Heterogeneous preferences, spousal interaction, and couples' time-use
authors: Monika Merz, Almut Balleer, Tamás K. Papp
official: 官方在线 2024-10-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the role of heterogenous preferences at the spousal level and that of spousal mutual insurance against wage shocks for couples’ labor supply in a time-use model. We estimate the model for couples in the German Time-Use Survey with Bayesian techniques and generate gender-specific wage-elasticities of market hours in the cross-section and for all couples. Missing mutual insurance ignores males’ behavior which we find to be substantial. Together with preference heterogeneity it shapes the elasticities’ size and distribution, especially for high and low hours worked and wage groups. Our setting is suitable to analyze nonlinear and distributional economic policy.
abstract_zh: 本文在时间利用模型中研究了配偶层面异质性偏好以及配偶间工资冲击相互保险对夫妻劳动供给的作用。我们采用贝叶斯方法，基于德国时间利用调查数据对模型进行估计，并生成了截面层面及所有夫妻的性别特异性市场工时工资弹性。缺失相互保险会忽略男性的行为，而我们的研究发现这种行为影响显著。与偏好异质性共同作用，这种缺失塑造了弹性的大小与分布，尤其在高、低工时及工资群体中表现突出。我们的研究框架适用于分析非线性及分布性经济政策。
